title: Dry-aged Strip Loin with Onion Three Ways, Caramelized Garlic & Confit Potato

methodSections.heading: Pickled Chipolini (1 day in advance)
steps: Peel and slice the onions into 5mm rings. Bring the juice and vinegar to a boil and dissolve the sugar in the mixture.
Place onions in a glass jar and fill with the warm vinegared juice. Allow to rest for 1 day.

methodSections.heading: White Onion Purée
steps: Slice the onions into rings and sweat in a large pot using 30g of the butter. Keep stirring and keep the temperature low enough that the onions don't colour.
Add the white wine, salt and herbs. Cook on a low temperature with a lid on for about 15 minutes or until they are very soft.
Finely strain and reserve the liquid, remove the herbs and then blend the onions while adding the remaining 70g of cold butter slowly.
If the resulting purée is too thick, add some of the strained juices.

methodSections.heading: Charred Chipolini Onions
steps: Blanch the chipolini for about 90 seconds in boiling water. Immediately cool in ice water to stop the cooking.
Slice in half or into thick disks and sear in a hot pan with the oil until they have a nearly burnt colour. Season with salt.

methodSections.heading: Caramelized Garlic Purée
steps: Roast the garlic in a hot pan with olive oil until brown. Add the sugar and allow to caramelize slightly. Add the water, vinegar and salt, and simmer until the garlic is soft.
Strain, reserving the liquid, and then blend garlic. Add the butter and then slowly add some of the strained liquid until purée is smooth.

methodSections.heading: Confit Beef Fat Potato
steps: Peel the potatoes and slice into 1cm (½in) disks.
Bring the beef fat to 85°C (185°F) in a large pot. Confit the potato for roughly 30 minutes or until soft.
Remove the potato from the fat, drain and season to taste.
If you have a smoker you can also smoke the potatoes for 10 minutes with hickory wood.

methodSections.heading: Dry-Aged Strip Loin
steps: Bring a pan to a very high heat. Salt the steaks all over and sear them on all sides.
Finish the cooking in the oven until the middle is 52°C (125°F) for medium rare.
Let steaks rest for several minutes.
Top with hot veal or beef jus.
